## load in data

Please note that we cannot share the raw files that are being read here as they contain personally identifiable information such as email addressses. At the end of this file, we will have all the data in an anonymised and useable format.

```{r message=FALSE}
############
#main norms
############

#load in the raw data from the czlex_norming_raw folder
system.time(
  czlex_norming <- list.files(path = "data/norms_LABELS/", pattern = ".csv", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) %>%
    map_df(~read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
             mutate(across(.cols = everything(), .fns = as.character)) %>%
             mutate(ID = .x)) %>%
    type_convert()
)


##################
# demographics
##################

#make an object with the final participant list - filter out non-native Czech speakers and anybody with reading impairment, also anybody who did not complete the whole experiment
czlex_norming_participants <- czlex_norming %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n > 10) %>%
  mutate(Progress = ifelse(n == 11, 93, 100)) %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "demographics1") %>%
              select(subject, response) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as.data.frame())) %>%
              unnest(response))

#filter the raw data to include only the final participants
czlex_norming_filtered <- czlex_norming %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_participants$subject)

# get all the demographic data for the participants
czlex_norming_participants_demographics <- czlex_norming_filtered %>%
  filter(trial_type1 == "demographics1") %>%
  select(subject, response) %>%
  mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as.data.frame())) %>%
  unnest(response) %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_filtered %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "feedback") %>%
              select(subject, response) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as.data.frame())) %>%
              unnest(response)) %>%
  mutate(gender_scale = as.numeric(gender_scale),
         Věk = as.numeric(Věk),
         L2_language = as.numeric(L2_language),
         noiselevel = as.numeric(noiselevel),
         subject = as.character(subject)) %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_participants %>%
              mutate(subject = as.character(subject)) %>%
              select(subject, Progress))

# #write the demographics file to a csv
# czlex_norming_participants_demographics %>%
  # write_delim("demographics/czlex_norms_demographics.csv", ",")


###############
# rating data
###############

#convert all the raw data to long format
czlex_norming_filtered_long <- czlex_norming_filtered %>%
  filter(trial_type1 == "ratings_valence") %>%
  select(subject, response, word_list1) %>%
  mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as_tibble())) %>%
  unnest(response) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(-subject, -word_list1), values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(dimension = "valence") %>%
  bind_rows(czlex_norming_filtered %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "ratings_gender") %>%
              select(subject, response, word_list1) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as_tibble())) %>%
              unnest(response) %>%
              pivot_longer(c(-subject, -word_list1), values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
              mutate(dimension = "gender")) %>%
  bind_rows(czlex_norming_filtered %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "ratings_concreteness") %>%
              select(subject, response, word_list1) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as_tibble())) %>%
              unnest(response) %>%
              pivot_longer(c(-subject, -word_list1), values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
              mutate(dimension = "concreteness")) %>%
  bind_rows(czlex_norming_filtered %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "ratings_imageability") %>%
              select(subject, response, word_list1) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as_tibble())) %>%
              unnest(response) %>%
              pivot_longer(c(-subject, -word_list1), values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
              mutate(dimension = "imageability")) %>%
  bind_rows(czlex_norming_filtered %>%
              filter(trial_type1 == "ratings_aoa") %>%
              select(subject, response, word_list1) %>%
              mutate(response = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.) %>% as_tibble())) %>%
              unnest(response) %>%
              pivot_longer(c(-subject, -word_list1), values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
              mutate(dimension = "aoa")) %>%
  left_join(read_csv("data/word_lists_final.csv") %>%
              rename(name = word,
                     word_list2 = list1)) %>%
  mutate(value1 = ifelse(value %in% c("unknown", "unkown", "", "111"), NA, value),
         unknown = ifelse(value == "unknown", 1, 0),
         value1 = as.numeric(value1),
         value1 = ifelse(value1 > 30, NA, value1),
         subject = as.character(subject),
         word_list = ifelse(str_length(as.character(word_list2)) == 1, paste0("00", word_list2), paste0("0", word_list2))) %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_participants_demographics$subject)

################
#sociolex wordlists
################

#note this data was collected before the czlex data, it was collected using Qualtrics, so the file formats differ
filenames <- list.files(path = "data/PRIMUS_data/data/")

awl_data <- tibble()
awl_demographic <- tibble()

for (i in filenames) {
  
  awl_data2 <- read_csv(paste0("data/PRIMUS_data/data/", i), skip = 1) %>%
    slice(-1) %>%
    rename(participant_feedback = which(str_starts(colnames(.), "To je ")))
  
  awl_data1a <- awl_data2 %>%
    select(-`IMAGEABILITY - orel`:-participant_feedback) %>%
    select(-starts_with("Timing")) %>%
    rename(participant_email_address = 18,
           participant_gender_category = 24,
           participant_gender_category_other = 25,
           participant_gender_scale = 26,
           participant_age = 28,
           participant_language = 29,
           participant_language_other = 30,
           participant_education = 31,
           participant_political_scale = 32,
           participant_optimism_scale = 33,
           participant_location_scale = 34,
           duration = 6,
           Response_ID = 9,
           participant_start_time = 1) %>%
    mutate(survey_version = i)
  
  awl_data1 <- awl_data2 %>%
    rename(Response_ID = `Response ID`) %>%
    select(Response_ID, `IMAGEABILITY - orel`:participant_feedback) %>%
    select(-starts_with("Timing"), -participant_feedback) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Response_ID)
  
  awl_data <<- bind_rows(awl_data, awl_data1)
  awl_demographic <<- bind_rows(awl_demographic, awl_data1a)
  
}

  awl_data1a <- awl_data2 %>%

    select(-starts_with("Timing")) %>%
    rename(participant_email_address = 18,
           participant_gender_category = 24,
           participant_gender_category_other = 25,
           participant_gender_scale = 26,
           participant_age = 28,
           participant_language = 29,
           participant_language_other = 30,
           participant_education = 31,
           participant_political_scale = 32,
           participant_optimism_scale = 33,
           participant_location_scale = 34,
           duration = 6,
           Response_ID = 9,
           participant_start_time = 1) %>%
    mutate(survey_version = i)

#demographics
awl_demographic_all <- awl_demographic %>%
  bind_rows(awl_demographic_other) %>%
  mutate(Progress = as.numeric(Progress),
         participant_gender_category = ifelse(participant_gender_category == "jiné (prosím upřesněte níže)", "Nebinární", str_to_sentence(participant_gender_category)),
         participant_gender_scale = ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typická žena 3", 7,
                                           ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typická žena 2", 6,
                                                  ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typická žena 1", 5,
                                                         ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "neutralní", 4,
                                                                ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typický muž 1", 3,
                                                                       ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typický muž 2", 2,
                                                                              ifelse(participant_gender_scale == "typický muž 3", 1, -999
                                                                              ))))))),
         participant_language = ifelse(participant_language == "čeština", "Čeština", "další"),
         survey_version = str_remove(survey_version, "_November.*")) %>%
  filter(Progress > 90) %>%
  rename(subject = Response_ID,
         gender = participant_gender_category,
         gender_scale = participant_gender_scale,
         education = participant_education,
         age = participant_age,
         language = participant_language,
         language1 = participant_language_other,
         list = survey_version) %>%
  select(subject, gender, gender_scale, age, language, language1, list, Progress)

#rating data
awl_data_long <- awl_data %>%
  bind_rows(awl_data_other) %>%
  filter(!str_starts(name, "AOA")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("dimension", "name"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(value == "Toto slovo neznám", "Toto slovo neznám",
                        ifelse(!str_detect(value, "_"), str_sub(value, -1, -1), value)),
         value = ifelse(value == "IM_d4LDVoT3aymQyd8", 1,
                        ifelse(value == "IM_ag8a3QEwz5Xl9Nc", 2,
                               ifelse(value == "IM_78MP5zgK9S7NQNw", 3,
                                      ifelse(value == "IM_e4eZzCrZYpmKjDE", 4,
                                             ifelse(value == "IM_bCUwqdnHQzDg902", 5, value))))),
         value = ifelse(value == "Toto slovo neznám", "unknown", value),
         dimension = tolower(dimension),
         value = ifelse(value == "\n", 7, value)) %>%
  rename(subject = Response_ID) %>%
  filter(dimension != "arousal") %>%
  filter(subject %in% awl_demographic_all$subject)

#aoa ratings
awl_data_aoa <- awl_data %>%
  bind_rows(awl_data_other) %>%
  filter(str_detect(name, "AOA#1")) %>%
  mutate(name = str_sub(name, 15, -7)) %>%
  rename(aoa = value) %>%
  mutate(aoa = str_remove_all(aoa, "[^0-9.-]"),
         aoa = ifelse(aoa == "", NA, aoa),
         aoa = as.numeric(as.character(aoa))) %>%
  left_join(awl_data %>%
              bind_rows(awl_data_other) %>%
              filter(str_detect(name, "AOA#2")) %>%
              mutate(name = str_sub(name, 15, -1)) %>%
              rename(aoa_unknown = value)) %>%
  mutate(aoa = ifelse(!is.na(aoa_unknown), NA, aoa)) %>%
  rename(subject = Response_ID,
         value = aoa) %>%
  mutate(dimension = "aoa",
         value = ifelse(!is.na(value), value,
                        ifelse(aoa_unknown == "Toto slovo neznám", "unknown", value))) %>%
  select(-aoa_unknown) %>%
  filter(subject %in% awl_demographic_all$subject)

###################
#sociolex data - gender and valence
###################

sociolex_norms_data <- read_csv("data/Sociolex_norms/sociolex_ratings_words.csv") %>%
  filter(dimension %in% c("gender", "valence"))

sociolex_norms_demographics <- read_csv("data/Sociolex_norms/sociolex_demographics_words.csv") %>%
  filter(Response_ID %in% sociolex_norms_data$Response_ID)

```

## Merge all data

Create tibbles for the demographic and rating data that combines all of the data together.There is also a bit of tidyinging up of the variables for useability.

```{r}
czlex_norming_participants_demographics1 <- awl_demographic_all %>%
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age)) %>%
  select(subject, age, gender, gender_scale, language, language1, Progress) %>%
  bind_rows(czlex_norming_participants_demographics %>%
              rename(age = Věk) %>%
              select(subject, age, gender, gender_scale, language, language1, Progress)) %>%
  bind_rows(sociolex_norms_demographics %>%
              rename(subject = Response_ID,
                     age = participant_age,
                     gender = participant_gender_category,
                     gender_scale = participant_gender_scale,
                     language = participant_language,
                     language1 = participant_language_other) %>%
              mutate(age = as.numeric(age),
                     gender = ifelse(gender == "female", "Žena",
                                     ifelse(gender == "male", "Muž",
                                            ifelse(participant_gender_category_other %in% c("nebinární", "nonbinary", "Post-genderist"), "Nebinární", "Nechci"))),
                     gender_scale = gender_scale + 4,
                     language = ifelse(language == "Czech", "Čeština", "další")) %>%
              select(subject, age, gender, gender_scale, language, language1, Progress)
            ) %>%
  mutate(gender = ifelse(gender == "Žena", "female",
                                     ifelse(gender == "Muž", "male",
                                            ifelse(gender == "Nebinární", "non-binary",
                                                   ifelse(gender == "Nechci", "not disclosed", "xxx")))),
         language = ifelse(language == "Čeština", "Czech", "other"))

czlex_norming_filtered_long1 <- czlex_norming_filtered_long %>%
  select(subject, dimension, name, value) %>%
  bind_rows(awl_data_long %>%
              bind_rows(awl_data_aoa) %>%
              select(subject, dimension, name, value)) %>%
  bind_rows(sociolex_norms_data %>%
              rename(subject = Response_ID,
                     name = item) %>%
              mutate(value = ifelse(!is.na(value1), value1,
                                    ifelse(value == "Toto slovo neznám", "unknown", "-999"))) %>%
              select(subject, dimension, name, value)) %>%
  mutate(value = ifelse(value == "", NA, value),
         value = ifelse(value == "unkown", "unknown", value),
         value = ifelse(is.na(value), "unknown", value))

```

## Give basic summary information about the data for reference

Rating data

```{r}
glimpse(czlex_norming_filtered_long1)

czlex_norming_filtered_long1 %>%
  summarise(n_participants = n_distinct(subject),
            n_items = n_distinct(name)) %>%
  bind_cols(czlex_norming_filtered_long1 %>%
              group_by(dimension) %>%
              summarise(n = n()) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = dimension, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_"))

czlex_norming_filtered_long1 %>%
  group_by(name, dimension) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dimension, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_") %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_filtered_long1 %>%
              mutate(value1 = ifelse(value == "unknown", 0, 1)) %>%
              group_by(name, dimension) %>%
              summarise(n_known = sum(value1)) %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = dimension, values_from = n_known, names_prefix = "n_known_"))

```
Demographic data

```{r}
glimpse(czlex_norming_participants_demographics1)

czlex_norming_participants_demographics1 %>%
  summarise(n_participants = n_distinct(subject),
            min_age = min(age),
            max_age = max(age),
            median_age = median(age)) %>%
  bind_cols(czlex_norming_participants_demographics1 %>%
              group_by(gender) %>%
              count() %>%
              pivot_wider(names_from = gender, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_"))

```

## Save the data

We will now export the data so it can be used for filtering.

```{r}
write_excel_csv(czlex_norming_filtered_long1, "raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_ratings_data.csv")
saveRDS(czlex_norming_filtered_long1, "raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_ratings_data.rds")

write_excel_csv(czlex_norming_participants_demographics1, "raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_demographic_data.csv")
saveRDS(czlex_norming_participants_demographics1, "raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_demographic_data.rds")

```
